label: Statements
description: Turns bank and card statement PDFs into transactions to review.

steps.label: Read scans
steps.description: Reads pages that are images. Pages with real text skip this step and use the PDF's own text.

adapters.label: GLM-OCR
adapters.description: A small vision model that reads each page as an image.

adapters.label: Docling
adapters.description: Finds the table on each page and reads it with PaddleOCR. No AI provider needed.

steps.label: Extract
steps.description: Turns the page text into transactions using the statement's column layout.

adapters.label: Column layout
adapters.description: Finds the header line and puts each word in the column it sits under. No AI.

steps.label: Fallback
steps.description: Runs when the rows don't add up to the statement's balances and totals, or when you ask. Keeps whichever result checks out better.

adapters.label: Your AI
adapters.description: Sends the statement text to your own AI provider, one page at a time.

steps.label: Save
steps.description: Saves the rows for you to review and match against your transactions.
